answer: The honest road is short; the farm's road is long, costly, and watched at every step. One proof, one bench, one pair of hands: Patented forest warden deer count file with county assize attestation is the proof, and the bench work is 6-year stewardship, 41 supervised woodlands, wardenship assessment, keeping dues. One jetty per pair of hands, one ocean per purse, one terrace per winter: the farm must find all three, again and again. The price of one fake is 53 POA and 18 minutes; the price of 371 fakes is 19663 POA and 6678 minutes.
